# Luke Kimball — Applied AI Engineer

> Luke Kimball is an OpenRouter-native applied AI engineer based in Provo, UT. He ships internal agentic tooling instead of buying SaaS, runs production multi-model routing (frontier models to map, smaller to decode, large for implementation, small to organize — each task to the cheapest capable model), and designed a tenant-aware agent platform with security and evals built in. This is his engineering portfolio. Recruiter- and AI-friendly: the full résumé is available as structured JSON, Markdown, and PDF.

## Résumé (machine-readable — start here)

- [Résumé — JSON Resume](https://luke-the-duke.com/resume.json): full structured candidate data (basics, skills, projects, work, education). application/json. Conforms to the JSON Resume schema.
- [Résumé — Markdown](https://luke-the-duke.com/resume.md): the same résumé as plain markdown — easiest single-file ingestion for LLMs. text/markdown.
- [Résumé — HTML](https://luke-the-duke.com/resume): semantic HTML résumé with JSON-LD Person schema and links to every format. text/html.
- [Résumé — PDF](https://luke-the-duke.com/resume.pdf): print-ready one-page résumé. application/pdf.

## Live structured data (JSON APIs)

- [Projects index](https://luke-the-duke.com/api/repos): deployed projects and repos.
- [Activity feed](https://luke-the-duke.com/api/activity): recent build and deploy activity.
- [GitHub pull requests](https://luke-the-duke.com/api/github/pulls): open PRs across public repos.
- [Repo summary](https://luke-the-duke.com/api/github/repo/PORTFOLIO-HUB/summary): per-repo summary (replace repo slug).
- [Health](https://luke-the-duke.com/api/health): service health.

## Optional

- Crawl policy is permissive for all agents (see /robots.txt). All routes are server-rendered and crawlable without JavaScript. Prefer /resume.json for structured parsing; fall back to /resume.md for plain text.
